summary: Iteration 9 — Tested TeamNest.ai 'Find Your Friends' v1: 9 new backend invite endpoints + FindFriends page (4 tabs) + public /join/{token} flow + sidebar nav + invalid-token error card. BACKEND: created /app/backend/tests/test_iteration9_invites.py with 20 tests (TestInviteLink × 6, TestPublicInvite × 5, TestBulkInvite × 5, TestPendingList × 2, TestSuggestions × 2). 20/20 PASS. Full regression: 106/108 pass (2 pre-existing flakes: test_integrations CoinGecko 429 + test_iteration8 favorite_bias_soft — both noted as flaky in iter7/iter8). FRONTEND E2E (Amit demo via TRY DEMO WORKSPACE button): /find-friends loads; all 4 tabs (ff-tab-link, ff-tab-bulk, ff-tab-suggest, ff-tab-pending) present & clickable; magic-link card shows full preview-origin /join/<token> share URL; QR uses api.qrserver.com; Copy button toggles to 'Copied' (verified by reading copied state code: setCopied(true)+1.8s timeout); 3 share buttons (WhatsApp/SMS/Email) present; rotate button visible (owner role); Bulk tab parses 4 valid emails from comma+newline+junk paste, prepare label updates to 'Prepare 4 invites', preview renders with subject/body; mailto open button is a <Button onClick=openEmailClient> (not <a href>, but the api response carries mailto_url which is properly encoded and verified in backend tests). Pending tab shows ~15 pending rows (from bulk-invite seeding in tests). Suggest tab on demo.team renders ff-suggest-card (generic-domain empty state). Public /join/{invalid_token} shows join-error card. Public /join/{valid_token} (logged out) renders workspace name 'Emergent Demo Workspace', join-form fills, submit redirects to /dashboard, eat_token persists in localStorage — full join flow works end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py now ~1786 lines — module split (auth/invites/chats/research) is still pending from iter4-iter8 reviews. INVITES section is well-isolated and could be the easiest first router-split.
Models use pydantic EmailStr which rejects RFC-reserved .test / .example TLDs. Real users won't trip this, but tests must use real-looking domains. Documented in test file.
POST /invites/bulk does N sequential awaits for find_one + insert_one per email; for the 200-email cap this is ~400 round-trips. Consider Mongo bulk_write upserts. Not critical for v1.
GET /invites refresh-to-accepted loop performs N find_one + update_one for each pending row. Use a $lookup or precompute the set of joined emails. Minor scale concern.

_get_active_link returns None when use_count >= max_uses BUT does NOT mark the link revoked; the link is still queryable via /public/invite/{token} which separately enforces 410. Behavior is correct, but link state is inconsistent (still in DB as revoked:false with use_count==max_uses). Consider auto-revoke on exhaustion for cleanliness.

FindFriends.jsx ff-bulk-open-mailto is a <Button onClick=openEmailClient> with no fallback <a href={mailto_url}> visible — works in JS-enabled browsers but blocks middle-click / right-click 'copy link' UX. The hidden <a> at line 504 is dead code (ref callback always false). Either expose the anchor or accept this trade-off.
JoinWorkspace.jsx submit on success sets token via context — verified eat_token appears in localStorage and /dashboard loads as the NEW user (E2E Join shown in sidebar). Good.

Suggestions endpoint masks the email but ALSO returns real_email in the same payload — defeats the masking. Either drop real_email from response OR document that it's used by the UI to send the invite (in which case masking is just for display).

success_rate.backend: 100% on new tests (20/20); 98% overall regression (106/108, 2 pre-existing flakes unrelated to this iteration)
success_rate.frontend: 100% — every Find-Friends flow tested works: sidebar nav, 4 tabs, magic link card, copy, rotate, share, QR, bulk paste+parse+prepare+preview, pending list, suggest empty-state, /join/{invalid} error card, /join/{valid} no-auth landing + form submit + auto-login

Also 2 corporate-domain users (alice_/bob_ @acmebrand.co) for suggestion test. No teardown — these are test users, can be cleaned via cleanup script if needed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file is /app/backend/tests/test_iteration9_invites.py. Use real-looking domains (acmebrand.co) NOT .test/.example since pydantic EmailStr rejects reserved TLDs. To frontend-login programmatically, EITHER click the 'TRY DEMO WORKSPACE' button on /login (cleanest) OR set localStorage key 'eat_token' (NOT 'auth_token'). The Find Friends page uses data-testid prefix ff-* for all interactive elements (ff-tab-{link|bulk|suggest|pending}, ff-magic-link-card, ff-share-url, ff-copy-link, ff-rotate-link, ff-share-{whatsapp|sms|email}, ff-qr-card, ff-generate-link, ff-bulk-emails, ff-email-count, ff-bulk-note, ff-bulk-prepare, ff-bulk-preview, ff-bulk-open-mailto, ff-csv-upload, ff-csv-input, ff-suggest-card, ff-suggest-{idx}, ff-pending-card, ff-pending-row-{id}, ff-cancel-{id}). Public join page uses join-card, join-error, join-workspace-name, join-name, join-email, join-password, join-submit, join-back-home, join-form. The dashboard small-workspace invite banner was NOT visually verified (demo has 14 members, banner threshold is ≤2) — main agent can self-test by setting localStorage and visiting /dashboard with a fresh workspace. CSV upload was NOT exercised (would need file injection); the input has data-testid='ff-csv-input' if needed.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. The only false-positives during test development were: (1) my test domain '.test' is rejected by pydantic EmailStr — switched to 'acmebrand.co'; (2) /api/auth/signup ignores any 'workspace_name' field and always generates '<Name>'s Workspace' — updated assertion. Neither is a real bug.
